name: Undercover Lover
source:
About to embark on your first undercover operation, you head out for one last night of fun. Little did you know that this fun would later complicate matters.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
在即将执行人生第一次卧底行动的前夕，你出门享受了最后一晚的狂欢寻乐。然而你万万没有想到，这一夜的风流竟会让日后的局面变得错综复杂。

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
